def _gen_alias_field(self, state: GenState, crown: InpFieldCrown, field: InputField):
        keys = (state.path[-1], *crown.aliases)
        parent = state.parent
        suffix = state.path_to_suffix[state.path]
        resolved = f"resolved_key_{suffix}"
        present = f"present_keys_{suffix}"
        with state.builder(f"if not isinstance({parent.v_data}, CollectionsMapping):"):
            self._gen_raise_bad_type_error(state, f"TypeLoadError(CollectionsMapping, {parent.v_data})", namer=parent)
        state.type_checked_type_paths.add(state.parent_path)
        state.builder += f"{present} = [key for key in {keys!r} if key in {parent.v_data}]"
        with state.builder(f"if len({present}) > 1:"):
            state.builder += parent.emit_error(f"ExtraFieldsLoadError(set({present}[1:]), {parent.v_data})")
        with state.builder(f"if {present}:"):
            state.builder += f"{resolved} = {present}[0]"
            if self._is_packed_field(field):
                target = f"packed_fields[{self._field_id_to_param[field.id].name!r}]"
            else:
                target = state.v_field(field)
            loader_arg = f"{parent.v_data}[{resolved}]"
            processing = loader_arg if self._field_loaders[field.id] == as_is_stub else f"{state.v_field_loader(field.id)}({loader_arg})"
            if self._debug_trail == DebugTrail.DISABLE:
                state.builder += f"{target} = {processing}"
            else:
                with state.builder("try:"):
                    state.builder += f"{target} = {processing}"
                with state.builder("except Exception as e:"):
                    trail = f"append_trail(e, {resolved})"
                    if parent.path:
                        trail = parent.with_trail(trail)
                    if self._debug_trail == DebugTrail.ALL:
                        state.builder += f"errors.append({trail})"
                    else:
                        state.builder += f"raise {trail}"
        with state.builder("else:"):
            if field.is_required:
                state.builder += parent.emit_error(f"NoRequiredFieldsLoadError({{{keys[0]!r}}}, {parent.v_data})")
            elif self._is_packed_field(field):
                state.builder += "pass"
            else:
                state.builder += f"{state.v_field(field)} = {self._get_default_clause_expr(state, field)}"
        state.builder.empty_line()
